competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Covers Portuguese GPs/LPs/funds as part of pan-European alternatives coverage — strongest on fund vehicles, LP commitments and performance estimates; PT depth is modest (few dozen active GPs).
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: CMVM register of management companies and funds (our route: ESMA registers, since CMVM portal is JS-blocked), APCRI member roster, APFIPP AUM statistics, fund annual reports, Diário da República fund-vehicle acts.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: PT PE/VC deal and company coverage via news-driven collection plus registry lookups; good on cross-border buyouts touching Portugal, thinner on domestic small-cap.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Company-act publications (publicacoes.mj.pt), Diário da República, Euronext Lisbon issuer disclosures, and press (ECO, Jornal de Negócios, Jornal Económico) — all directly cataloged here.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Strong Lisbon/Porto startup ecosystem coverage; runs ecosystem mapping in partnership with government startup bodies.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup Portugal ecosystem mapping platform and reports, Portugal Ventures portfolio pages, accelerator/incubator portfolio lists, startup media (Link to Leaders, ECO) — all public and cataloged.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Broad but shallow PT startup coverage, largely self-reported profiles plus funding-round press.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Startup press releases and PT startup media; the underlying verifiable layer is the same publicacoes.mj.pt incorporation/act stream and news RSS we catalog.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Iberia-specialist M&A/PE/VC deal database — arguably the deepest deal coverage for Portugal specifically, including mid-market and advisor league tables.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Registry act publications (publicacoes.mj.pt), Diário da República, CMVM/Euronext issuer filings, CITIUS insolvency publicity, law-firm deal announcements and Iberian legal press (Iberian Lawyer).

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: The dominant local company-information/credit provider — financials, risk scores, ESG scores, directories on effectively all PT companies; sells 'public data files' and database licensing.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: IRN commercial register publications, IES annual accounts filings (official channel), Diário da República, CITIUS insolvency data, Portal BASE procurement — the same official spine we ingest directly at $0.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Free local company-directory site (company events, dissolutions, statistics) demonstrating what is derivable purely from open registry publications; site itself 403s bots and we do not scrape competitors.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: publicacoes.mj.pt company acts and Diário da República — go direct to those.

competitorAnalysis.coverageNotes: Local real-estate data house (SIR residential index, Portuguese Housing Market Survey) — the reference for PT housing/investment price data; site is JS-heavy, content behind subscription.
competitorAnalysis.publicSourcesTheyUse: Built on proprietary deed/agency panels; the public alternatives we catalog are INE housing statistics and Portal BASE/registry data, plus Iberian Property and Vida Imobiliária for deal signals.

searchedButAbsent: Searched for but absent or unusable: (1) No open/bulk route to the commercial register itself — Portugal has no free bulk company register download or API; only the free per-act publications index (publicacoes.mj.pt) and the paid per-company certidão permanente. (2) RCBE (beneficial-ownership register) exists but public access is restricted post-CJEU — correctly treated as closed per project rules. (3) CMVM legacy machine endpoints (web3.cmvm.pt/sdi and /sdi2004) are dead (404) — the registers now live only behind the JS-blocked main portal; ESMA registers are the working alternate. (4) FNABA (business angels federation) — fnaba.org currently 302-redirects to an unrelated spam domain (wikimoderator.com); no working official site found, so it was excluded. (5) Idealista News RSS (/news/rss) 404s. (6) Público and Expresso feeds could not be confirmed — both domains block automated fetch (403 / connection refused). (7) No dedicated public register of NPL/credit servicers found as a standalone list — credit-servicing licensees sit inside Banco de Portugal's bot-blocked Entidades Autorizadas register. (8) No Portuguese litigation-funding association or dedicated carbon-market association found. (9) APA (EU ETS national administrator) refused connections from our fetcher, and APS (insurers association) loops redirects — both real but unverifiable this run. Note: the session's web-search budget was exhausted at task start, so all verification was done by direct URL fetches; a handful of well-known sources (EBA EUCLID, EIOPA, OROC, DGEG, RICS firms directory, Portugal Fintech) are included with accessMethod marked unknown/api and explicit not-fetched caveats rather than fabricated verdicts.
